# FG-AGENT-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `publish_denied_for_tag_author` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自分が作った・tag を付けた・push した部品の版は、自分では公開できません。マーケットプレイスの別の Maintainer に公開を頼んでください。
- en: You cannot publish a part version you authored, tagged or pushed yourself. Ask another marketplace Maintainer to publish it.
- id: Anda tidak dapat menerbitkan versi bagian yang Anda buat, beri tag, atau push sendiri. Minta Maintainer marketplace lain untuk menerbitkannya.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 §4 (ADR-0032 Amendment A4, two-person rule): `authorize()` refused `AgentPartPublish` or `AgentPartPromote` because the caller is one of the people behind the tag — the tag's pusher from the push audit (`AgentPartView::tag_pusher`), or its tagger, or the tagged commit's author or committer, as accounts (`tag_authors`), loaded by the publishing route. A tag whose pusher is unknown is refused as `FG-AUTH-0003 reason=tag_pusher_unknown` (fails closed). Administrators included. `reason`: `tag_author`. Nothing was published or changed.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `action`, `reason` and `request_id`; the route's own event names the part (`slug`, `version`, `tag`). `git for-each-ref refs/tags/<slug>/<version> --format='%(taggername) %(*authorname) %(*committername)'` on the parts repository shows the identities behind the tag.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server: another Maintainer of the publishing group (or an administrator) who did not author the tag publishes or promotes it.
